title: Vegan Wine-Glazed Lentil Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan bowl filled with wine-glazed lentils, served with crisp vegetables.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the lentils and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the red wine and 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the x and crisp to the saucepan with the wine glaze. Simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the wine-glazed lentils in the bottom of a bowl, topped with additional x and crisp.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
